cases.name: Barbara Elaine Hovey Novaes
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Barb’s life was a gift to all who knew her, and she filled it with love. Her infectious smile would light up a room, and her hugs were frequent and fully enveloping.

Barb was born on March 28,1961 in Utica, NY to Ronald Hovey Sr. and Gertrude Briggs Hovey. Barb was a graduate of Whitesboro High School, Class of 1979, where she was active in cheerleading, A’Cappella choir, field hockey, yearbook committee, prep band, Spanish Club, the float committee, her sorority, and amassing friends. Outside of school she played the violin, organ, flute, and also Whitestown softball. She was a graduate of SUNY Delhi and SUNY IT. With a rich and eclectic work history, which included doing makeup artistry for Chanel and managing a hotel’s VIP wing, Barb finally settled into her position as Assistant Vice President and Branch Manager at Everett Cooperative Bank, where she was a valued employee and cherished friend to colleagues and customers.

Barb was a woman of endless talents. She was quite creative, whether cooking her specialty gourmet dishes, sharing her angelic singing voice, or teaching ESL in Brazil as Barb was multilingual. She was a die-hard Red Sox fan in a family of Yankee devotees. She always enjoyed her time by the water, either on an ocean’s beach or lakeside in the Adirondacks, reading a favorite book. More recently she was content to sit on her back porch watching the birds, especially the cardinal she viewed as her daily visit from Dad.

Supported and restored by her Christian faith, Barbie strived to make everyone she met feel appreciated, validated, and loved."
cases.narrative: On 5/23/2022, her body was found in a recycling bin underneath her porch.She had no obvious signs of trauma.
